failures.message:
expected JrcContactCenter::OperationError with "ending_reason_already_confirmed", got #<JrcContactCenter::OperationError: stale_configuration_revision> with backtrace:
  # ./app/services/jrc_contact_center/configuration_revision.rb:24:in 'JrcContactCenter::ConfigurationRevision.check_token!'
  # ./app/services/jrc_contact_center/qualification_draft_revision.rb:19:in 'JrcContactCenter::QualificationDraftRevision.check!'

  # ./app/services/jrc_contact_center/qualification_draft.rb:14:in 'JrcContactCenter::QualificationDraft#save!'
  # ./app/services/jrc_contact_center/qualification_manager.rb:40:in 'JrcContactCenter::QualificationManager#save_draft!'
  # ./spec/services/jrc_contact_center/confirm_ending_reason_spec.rb:111:in 'block (3 levels) in <main>'
  # ./spec/services/jrc_contact_center/confirm_ending_reason_spec.rb:112:in 'block (2 levels) in <main>'

cause: The two new service callers computed the next draft token from the original preconfirmation ActiveRecord instance. The service returns the freshly locked record; its expected revision must reflect the persisted confirmed state.
correction_prepared: Reload before computing the next revision; retain all notes, completion, fixed-reason and immutable-ledger expectations. Add a case requiring the previously valid revision to remain rejected, without rewriting notes or confirmation.
functional_code_changed: Only extract the existing authorized form-context payload composition; no response, authorization or persistence semantics changed.
